title: 第三章 前朝老将震惊众人第四章 天翻地覆外界变化
slug: 修炼一天抵十年莫欺老年穷
lines: “民国了？”
林玄眉头一皱，看着甲板上的几位明显有着中式面孔的年轻人，心中忽然明悟过来。
他们穿的是民国的服饰。
和前世大差不差。
所以。
自己被困二十三年，大景亡了？
嗯，还是问一下吧。
“大景王朝可还在？”
沙哑蹩脚声音从他口中发出。
二十三年没和人说话，语言功能几乎退化。
眼前这群人全都无比震惊的看着林玄。
但忽然，扎着双马尾的女学生眼瞳收缩，认出了林玄那一身老式军服。
“你...你是前朝海军老兵？”
双马尾的女学生露出震惊，看向林玄。
“什么？前朝老兵？”
“天啊，他身上好像还穿着前朝海军军服？”
“是的，那就是大景朝的海军军服，我在书上曾看到过。”
有学生露出震惊，七嘴八舌，心中的恐惧一下消散了不少。
而后有人快速搬来摄像机，对着林玄就来了几张，发出咔咔声音，白光耀眼。
林玄眉头皱起，却并未阻止他们。
“老先生，大景王朝已经不在了，在六年前被推翻，现在是大夏新国六年！”
那双马尾女学生大着胆子，出口回应。
“新国六年...”
林玄重复。
也就是民国六年。
好！
灭得好！！！
哈哈哈哈...
林玄突然放声大笑，须发狂舞，声音震耳欲聋。
众人脸色变幻。
莫非这位前朝老兵因思念前朝旧国，现在听闻旧国灭亡，精神承受不住，直接疯了？
还有！
他怎么突然从海面上冒出来？
还能把手枪给捏碎？
这能是人？
“老先生，您千万要看开点。”
那双马尾女学生忍不住劝道：“大景王朝乃封建帝制，压迫世人，剥削百姓，签订无数丧权辱国条约，灭亡乃是历史之必然，现在大夏新国建立，人人自由平等，再也没有剥削和压迫...”
“是吗？”
林玄突然露出冷笑，深邃眼眸扫向女学生。
新国六年。
如果这个世界的历史和前世依旧相似的话。
那么现在应该是北洋执政时期吧？
“可还有洋人租界？”
content_en:
"The Republic of China?"
Lin Xuan frowned, looking at the several young people on the deck who clearly had Chinese faces, and suddenly realized something in his heart.
They were wearing the costumes of the Republic of China.
Very different from the previous life.
so.
I have been trapped for twenty-three years, and Dajing is dead?
Well, let’s ask.
"Is the Dajing Dynasty still there?"
A hoarse voice came from his mouth.
I haven’t spoken to anyone for twenty-three years, and my language function has almost deteriorated.
The group of people in front of them all looked at Lin Xuan in shock.
But suddenly, the female student with twin ponytails narrowed her eyes and recognized Lin Xuan's old-fashioned military uniform.
"You...are you a veteran of the former navy?"
The female student with twin tails looked shocked and looked at Lin Xuan.
"What? A veteran of the former dynasty?"
"Oh my God, he seems to be wearing the navy uniform of the former dynasty?"
"Yes, that is the naval uniform of the Great Jing Dynasty. I have seen it in a book."
Some students showed shock and chattered, and the fear in their hearts dissipated a lot.
Then someone quickly moved the camera and took a few photos of Lin Xuan, making a clicking sound and a dazzling white light.
Lin Xuan frowned, but did not stop them.
"Old sir, the Dajing Dynasty is no longer there. It was overthrown six years ago. It is now the sixth year of the New Kingdom of Daxia!"
The pony-tailed female student boldly responded.
"The sixth year of the New Kingdom..."
Lin Xuan repeated.
That is the sixth year of the Republic of China.
good!
Well done! ! !
Hahahaha...
Lin Xuan suddenly laughed loudly, his beard and hair dancing wildly, and the sound was deafening.
Everyone's expressions changed.
Could it be that this veteran from the previous dynasty missed his old country, and now that he heard that the old country was destroyed, he couldn't bear it mentally and went crazy?
besides!
Why did he suddenly emerge from the sea?
Can you still crush the pistol?
Could this be a human being?
"Old sir, you must be more open-minded."
The pony-tailed female student couldn't help but persuade: "The Dajing Dynasty was a feudal monarchy that oppressed the world, exploited the people, and signed countless power-degrading and humiliating treaties. Its demise is a historical necessity. Now that the new country of Daxia has been established, everyone is free and equal, and there is no more exploitation and oppression..."
"Really?"
Lin Xuan suddenly sneered and glanced at the female student with his deep eyes.
Six years of the New Kingdom.
If the history of this world is still similar to the previous life.
So this should be the period of Beiyang’s rule, right?
"Are there still foreign concessions?"
title_en: Chapter 3: The veteran of the previous dynasty shocked everyone Chapter 4: Earth-shaking changes in the outside world
